verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rovo AI near the status-reporting area: an AI-assist that keeps work up to date by tracking progress from tools like Slack and Gmail, Rovo automations to keep status current, and Rovo identifying trends and bottlenecks. None of it explicitly says AI writes a narrative project or initiative status update from recent activity. missing for 10: explicit AI-drafted status update or summary feature, initiative-level rollup summarization, documentation of how drafts are generated from recent activity, hands-on or independent corroboration.
